def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    utilization = (bins - remaining) / bins if (bins != 0).any() else np.zeros_like(bins)
    utilization[~valid] = 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid] = utilization[valid]
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    utilization = (bins - remaining) / bins
    target_utilization = 0.5
    deviation = np.abs(utilization - target_utilization)
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid] = -deviation[valid]

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    current_loads = bins
    median_load = np.median(current_loads)
    deviations = np.abs(current_loads - median_load)
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid] = 1 / (deviations[valid] + 1e-8)
    return priority_scores

algorithm: {The algorithm prioritizes bins based on how close their current load is to a target load, rewarding bins that are closest to half their capacity to promote balanced utilization and avoid both underutilization and overfilling.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    target_load = bins / 2
    current_load = bins - remaining_capacity
    deviation_from_target = np.abs(current_load + item - target_load)
    priority_scores = -deviation_from_target
    return priority_scores
